# Moths
They can eat cotton, cloth, and clothing, but almost none of what others consider "food." They prefer slightly lower temperatures than humans. Their insectoid blood cannot be replenished with iron like ordinary blood.
Their wings give them better acceleration without gravity aboard the station, though they still cannot move through open space without equipment.
They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less cold damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]20% more heat damage and catch fire more easily[/color].
